note: The family’s wish and the actions of the offering are documented. The source for the king’s story explicitly identifies it as a sthala purana. These strands meet at the shrine. The historical survey does not establish a first person to perform the vow. November 2026 reporting places a recent observance at the associated Bheemeswara shrine. Avoid labelling an illustration as today’s precise route.
